limitations: Bootstrap intervals retain query-batch covariance within each run and do not estimate between-session uncertainty.
Two independent T4 sessions reproduce one fixed checkpoint, feature policy, schema and October 1 validation cohort; no broader cross-model or cross-schema claim follows.
Cross-mode sampler equality is supported by runtime assertions and saved shared fingerprints; raw sampled tensors are not exported for independent tensor replay.
The recurring batch-512 HGAM spike is retained in all predefined estimates; its cause remains unresolved.
Hosted snapshot historical foreign-key changes, deletions, merges and survivorship remain unresolved.

outlier_sensitivity.cause: Unresolved. Repeated position suggests a reproducible workload or execution event; raw timings do not identify garbage collection, allocation, or another cause.
